hits.snippet: For God so <mark>loved</mark> the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

matches.KJV: For God so <mark>loved</mark> the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
matches.WEB: For God so <mark>loved</mark> the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
